- 配方原文 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]：Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

### 候选资料：c3-dual-anion-bpg-0023（尚未获推荐）

- 配方原文 [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7]：2.3. Electrochemical measurements
The electrochemical performance was tested by CR2032 coin-type. The working electrodes were prepared by mixing 70 wt% active material, 20 wt% acetylene black and 10 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF). The slurry was coated on carbon-coated the Al foil and dried at 60 °C for 12 h in vacuum oven to obtain the testing electrodes. Two electrolytes were used for electrochemical tests. The dual-anion regulated electrolyte was prepared consisting of 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ and 0.2 M NaBF $_{4}$ in diethyleneglycol dimethyl ether. The electrolyte of 1 M NaPF $_{6}$ in propylene carbonate (PC) was selected as the reference electrolyte. The loading mass of the active material in the electrode was about 1.0 mg cm $^{-2}$ . The anode was pure Na metal foil and the separator was glass fiber (GF/D). The full cell was assembled by using HM-NVPF@CN cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode in BPG electrolyte. Before assembling the full cell, the hard carbon anode was pre-cycled for several cycles to form a stable electrode-electrolyte interface. Galvanostatic charge/discharge (GCD) and galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT) tests were conducted on a Neware system (CT-4008T-5V10mA-164, Shenzhen, China). Cyclic voltammetry (CV) curve analysis and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) were performed on a CHI660E electrochemical workstation.

## 候选评估
### c1-naclo4-ecpc-0036
评估建议：候选 1M NaClO4/EC:PC(1:1 vol) 确为该体系文献所用，并给出 HC 在 -20 °C 无析钠的 250 mAh g^-1 安全容量；但同一电解液的全电池在 -20 °C 因不稳定 SEI 容量快速衰减，原文明确呼吁优化电解液以构建稳定低温 SEI，因此不足以据此推荐其作为低温全电池的适宜电解液，暂不推荐。
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaClO4 at 1 M concentration：原文方法部分明确写“1M NaClO4 solution ... was applied as the electrolyte”，与候选盐和浓度一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Solvent system is EC/PC at 1:1 by volume：同一方法句给出“ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume)”，与候选溶剂及体积比基准一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Electrolyte is employed in the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 || hard-carbon full cell：原文说明该电解液用于半电池和全电池，且全电池正极为 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3、负极为 HC，与目标体系匹配。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child16]
- Determine the reversible no-plating capacity limit of the HC anode at -20 C：原文以原位 XRD/Raman 及光学观察定出 -20 °C 下 250 mAh g^-1 为无析钠的可逆安全容量，300 mAh g^-1 时库仑效率降至 95.3% 出现析钠。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7]
- No-plating limit is established for the full cell itself at -20 C：250 mAh g^-1 无析钠结论是在 HC 半电池上测得；原文报告的 -20 °C 全电池呈现明显容量下降（前几循环大幅衰减，10 循环后回 25 °C 仅恢复约 82%），并未给出全电池层面的无析钠上限。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17]
- Electrolyte supports a stable low-temperature full cell (stable SEI)：原文指出 -20 °C 下形成更厚（约 23 nm）且不稳定的 SEI 导致全电池容量快速衰减，并明确结论为未来需优化电解液体系以构建稳定 SEI，说明该碳酸酯电解液并非低温全电池的适宜选择。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child15][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7::child0]
文献与候选的关联：1M NaClO4/EC:PC(1:1 vol) 是本研究中 HC 半电池与 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC 全电池实际使用的电解液；250 mAh g^-1 无析钠上限由 HC 半电池的原位 XRD/Raman 与光学观察确立，而全电池在 -20 °C 出现容量快速衰减与更厚/不稳定 SEI，两个测量分属半电池与全电池、不能相互替代。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17]
### c2-naclo4-ecpc-fec-0391
评估建议：The candidate electrolyte is compositionally identical to and experimentally used in the target NVPF||hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell in the source, so it is scientifically supported as an appropriate electrolyte for this system; however, the specific reversible no-plating capacity limit at -20 C remains unaddressed by the literature and would require direct experimental determination.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaClO4 at 1 mol/L：The paper's electrolyte is described as 1 M NaClO4 dissolved in EC/PC with FEC, matching the candidate salt and concentration. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Solvent system is EC:PC at 1:1 by volume：The source states ethylene carbonate (EC) and propylene carbonate (PC) in 1:1 v/v, matching the candidate solvent ratio and volume basis. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Contains 5 vol% FEC additive：The source explicitly reports 5 vol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) as the electrolyte additive. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Electrolyte applied in a NVPF||hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell：The full cells were assembled with NVPF/CNTs cathode and hard carbon anode (chemically pre-sodiated), using this electrolyte, matching the target full-cell configuration. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec8::child22]
- Operation at -20 C：The explicit -20 C measurements (diffusion coefficients and 96.8 mAh g-1 / capacity retention) are on NVPF/CNTs cathode half-cells or GITT; the full-cell rate/cycling data (Fig. 7) are not reported at -20 C, so low-temperature full-cell behavior of this electrolyte is not directly demonstrated. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec8::child22][0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec9::child2]
- Determination of a reversible no-plating capacity limit：None of the provided chunks report sodium-plating detection, plating thresholds, or any no-plating/plating measurement for this electrolyte or cell; the sources only report capacity, rate, and cycling data. 
文献与候选的关联：The candidate electrolyte composition (1 M NaClO4 in EC:PC 1:1 v/v + 5 vol% FEC) is the same electrolyte described for fabricating and testing the NVPF/CNTs||hard-carbon full cells, so the electrolyte material-to-target-cell association is established by the source, even though the -20 C no-plating limit itself is not measured. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0][0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec8::child22]
### c3-dual-anion-bpg-0023
评估建议：The candidate composition matches the BPG electrolyte and the target NVPF||HC full cell chemistry is reported, but the key requirements of the task - a -20 C operating point and a reversible no-plating capacity limit - are not evidenced in the supplied sources, and no tool computation was recorded; therefore the workflow cannot conclude a recommended capacity limit or electrolyte for this condition and the decision is held.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: dual-anion NaPF6/NaBF4 in DEGDME (BPG) as the selected electrolyte：sec9 defines the dual-salt ether electrolyte as 0.8 M NaPF6 and 0.2 M NaBF4 in DEGDME, denoted BPG, matching the candidate composition; sec7 gives the same preparation. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9][0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7]
- Cathode is Na3V2(PO4)2F3 (NVPF)：Sources consistently describe NVPF (Na3V2(PO4)2F3) as the high-voltage cathode (theoretical 128 mAh g-1, 3.9 V vs Na/Na+). [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec3]
- Full cell configuration NVPF||hard-carbon (HC) anode：sec7 states the full cell was assembled using HM-NVPF@CN cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode in BPG electrolyte, with the HC pre-cycled. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7]
- Target operating temperature of -20 C for the full cell：Low-temperature data reported are -25 C for the cathode half cell and -10 C / 60 C for the full cell; no -20 C full-cell result is given, and -25 C half-cell data cannot be transferred to the -20 C full cell without an explicit transfer statement. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9::child8][0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9::child16]
- Reversible no-plating capacity limit (sodium plating threshold) for the full cell：The sources report reversible capacities, cycling stability and CE but never quantify or discuss a no-plating / plating-onset capacity limit; no direct plating observation or equivalent verification is provided. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9::child16]
- -20 C low-temperature capacity/rate data for the selected electrolyte：Reported low-temperature full-cell data are -10 C (and 60 C), and cathode data at -25 C; no -20 C datapoint exists in the supplied chunks. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9::child16]
文献与候选的关联：The BPG electrolyte is the same dual-anion electrolyte in which the HM-NVPF@CN||HC full cell (with pre-cycled HC anode) and the NVPF half cell were tested, so the electrolyte and cell chemistry association is established; however, the association does not extend to -20 C or to a no-plating limit, since the reported temperatures are -25 C (half cell) and -10/60 C (full cell) with no plating characterization. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7][0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9][0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec9::child16]
### c4-nadfob-g2-0070
评估建议：NaDFOB-G2 (1 M) is directly supported as a low-temperature SIB electrolyte with a hard-carbon full cell and NVPF-family cathode compatibility, satisfying the electrolyte-selection intent; the exact Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC no-plating capacity limit itself is not reported and remains a measurement to be performed in the workflow, which does not block recommending this electrolyte candidate.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Use NaDFOB as the electrolyte salt：The source reports NaDFOB as a standalone electrolyte salt for SIBs with high conductivity, solvent compatibility and film-forming ability. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child1][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec0::child0]
- Use G2 (diethylene glycol dimethyl ether / diglyme) as solvent：The work explicitly studies NaDFOB-G2 ether electrolytes and reports their electrochemical behavior. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child2]
- 1 mol/L NaDFOB concentration：The source specifies a 1 M NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte (conductivity/LSV characterization), matching the candidate concentration. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child2]
- Operation at -20 °C：The NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte shows 92.7% capacity retention at -20 °C vs 25 °C (84.8% even at -40 °C), outperforming NaPF6-G2. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
- Compatibility with the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode：The source only reports Na3V2(PO4)2F3 electrodes cycling stably over 200 cycles with NaDFOB-G2; the exact Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 stoichiometry is not shown, and no explicit transfer between these compositions is established. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
- Hard-carbon anode in a sodium-ion full cell：An Ah-level hard carbon (HC)//NFPP pouch cell using the NaDFOB-based ether electrolyte is demonstrated. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec0::child0][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3]
- Full-cell (not only half-cell) low-temperature performance：The NaDFOB-G2 pouch cells are reported to maintain performance across -40 to 60 °C and to cycle for 500 cycles. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt] [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7] Conclusion
In summary, a hard carbon material for NIBs is fabricated from low-cost biomass waste using a facile two-step thermal treatment. Compared to direct high-temperature carbonization, the pre-treatment at a medium temperature is beneficial to avoiding the selfactivation effect of impurities. An appropriate surface area and pore size distribution are obtained, enabling a stable capacity of around 300 mAh g $^{-1}$ . It also shows excellent performance at a temperature as low as -20 °C. A safe and reversible capacity of 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ can be obtained without Na plating at -20 °C, as evidenced by in situ XRD and Raman tests. As-prepared HC also delivers stable performance in the full cell coupling with a $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}$ cathode, demonstrated an energy density of 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ (based on the total weight of electrode) with decent cyclic stability at room temperature. Nevertheless, the full cell shows a fast capacity fading at -20 °C due to both the increased resistance and continuous consumption of Na ions. It calls for building stable SEI under low temperature in future studies.

The electrochemical performance was tested by CR2032 coin-type. The working electrodes were prepared by mixing 70 wt% active material, 20 wt% acetylene black and 10 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF). The slurry was coated on carbon-coated the Al foil and dried at 60 °C for 12 h in vacuum oven to obtain the testing electrodes. Two electrolytes were used for electrochemical tests. 优先考察接近该目标的实际测试结果；室温表现不能替代高温或低温使用依据。
近似目标没有容差时不虚构数值阈值。报告必须写出文献实测条件，并在 next_steps
交代目标条件下的验证；不能省略这个目标后把基础配方写成完整解决方案。
成本等定性目标也逐项说明已有依据和待验证事项，不能随硬条件通过而消失。
联合条件的 `electrode` 只写正负极材料，`cell_configuration` 单独写软包、扣式等
电池类型，不把两种信息混写在一个字段中。

## 适用场景

- 用户要求设计适用于特定工况（低温、高压、长循环等）的钠离子电池电解液；
- 用户提供多套候选配方要求评分筛选。

## 证据能力选择

检索查询根据当前用户问题生成，使用英文。先检索用户给出的电极对、电池形式、
温度、倍率或电流及目标性能，不预先限定用户没有指定的盐、溶剂或添加剂。
可把这些条件拆成多个查询，用 `search_literature_multiview` 合并结果；
不必在每个查询中同时塞入所有条件。用户给出的具体电流、容量或电压范围也可用来
定位相关实验，不能只用宽泛的“低温电解液”替代这些信息。
对于有辨识度的电极缩写、明确电流或容量，`resolve_literature_papers` 可补充
字面检索。向量结果未覆盖这些具体标识时，先用原标识检查字面命中，避免继续
围绕不符合电极或电流条件的论文扩展检索。使用用户原本给出的标识，不猜作者或题名。先查看返回的正文命中，
再决定是否值得进行论文内检索；无关的引用、另一种电池的结果不能用于推荐。
找到相关论文后，使用论文内检索分别取得组成、测试条件和性能，核对是否属于
同一配方与同一测试。机理或替代体系检索用于解决实际缺口，不是必做的检索次数。
参数建议：`top_k=10`，`per_query_top_k=8`，`max_per_paper=2`。
盐未指定时，不要只锚定向量检索第一次命中的盐：先用 `kg_query` 的
`find_materials_for_condition`，把 `material_types` 设为 `["SodiumSalt", "Electrolyte"]`，
查目标温度/条件下测试过的盐与电解液，再对返回的具体盐名逐个补向量检索。
双盐体系必须用「dual salt + 具体盐名」组合查询才能召回，单独查一个盐名往往召不回对应论文。
后续查询依据已有结果和 `DecisionState.evidence_gaps` 调整。

## 工作流

### 逆向设计例外：先诊断，筛选仅决定能否推荐配方

对于容量骤降、首圈库仑效率低、高压衰减、阻抗增长等 `inverse_design` 问题，先从检索证据中建立至少两个可区分的电解液侧假设，并提出能区分它们的 EIS、Raman、XPS、LSV、ICP、产气或对照实验。仍执行候选配方筛选，但筛选 `hold` 只禁止“推荐进入实验”的完整配方；不得因此省略诊断、混杂因素和条件化调整方向。报告必须区分“已被证据支持的诊断事实”与“待验证的调整方向”。

1. 解析用户目标与约束；把用户要求的每项条件写成结构化 `constraint_records`，例如：
   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。
   推荐前逐项核对用户要求与检查条件，避免漏掉正极、负极、电池形式、温度、倍率或指标定义。
   检索前先解释用户给出的数值条件：它描述什么物理量、单位如何理解、哪些信息尚不明确。
   这一解释依据用户描述的工作场景，在检索前定下，不能由后来检索到的论文或知识图谱记录
   反过来改写；其它论文里恰好出现同样的 “N C” 写法，只说明那些论文的用法，不能用来判断
   用户这句话。
   温度与倍率的单位必须分清。省略度符号的 C 不能直接视为充放电倍率。
   按它在句中的位置判断：直接修饰电芯、电池或其使用环境时（如 “a pouch cell at -30 C”、
   “a full cell around 50 C”），是温度；只有与充放电动作或倍率词连用时
   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，
   此时暂缓推荐，而不是把两种解释同时写成两条互斥的数值约束。
   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们
   同时写成必需的 `required_component`；每个选项应作为独立候选分别比较，不叠加互斥的必需组分。
   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，
   用现有 `evidence_claim` 表达候选须有相应工况下的直接测试依据，而非把近似目标
   改成精确相等、单边不等式或自行设定容差。逐候选判断时，`supported` 须引用该
   候选的实际测试条件与性能原句，`basis` 写清实测条件与目标的差别及其关联依据。
   只有其他工况的结果、测试建议或机理预测时，不能据此判近似工况要求已满足。
   没有相应测试依据就保留 `not_found` 并补证，不能删掉该要求后批准推荐，再把它
   放进 `next_steps`。有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的
   差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列。电极、电池形式和其他明确要求仍须检查。
   联合条件也须保留近似目标的含义：不得把近似值写成 `target_context` 中要求
   精确匹配的数值。近似工况及其电极、全电池归属可写在同一 `evidence_claim`
   中，引用实际共同测试的结果；组分身份等与工况无关的要求不并入该测试条件组。
   “低成本”等定性目标须区分文献提出的成本动机与已量化的价格优势；未提供价格数据
   时不得称已验证低成本。数值明确的用户要求仍按原值建立硬约束，不得因此放宽。
   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`
   会让任何数字都通过，等于没有检查。这类“须被报告/须成立”的指标改用
   `kind: "evidence_claim"`（见下），把该指标写成一句断言。
   `field_presence` 只用于检查候选的配方字段（`concentration_mol_l`、
   `solvent_ratios`、`additives` 等）是否显式填写，绝不用于表达“某项性能必须被报告”。
   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成
   `"kind": "field_presence", "field": "additives"` 这类把性能指标错配到配方字段的约束。
   ```json
   {
     "request": {
       "candidates": candidates,
       "constraint_records": [
         {
           "constraint_id": "temp-low",
           "description": "operating temperature ≤ -20°C",
           "kind": "temperature",
           "operator": "<=",
           "value": -20,
           "unit": "°C",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find low-temperature cycling evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "electrode-hard-carbon",
           "description": "hard carbon anode",
           "kind": "electrode_material",
           "evidence_terms": ["hard carbon", "hard-carbon"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find hard carbon anode evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "cell-half",
           "description": "sodium half-cell configuration",
           "kind": "cell_configuration",
           "evidence_terms": ["half-cell", "half cell", "Na||HC", "HC||Na", "pure Na"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find half-cell configuration evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "field-concentration",
           "description": "explicit salt concentration must be present",
           "kind": "field_presence",
           "field": "concentration_mol_l",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": false
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "salt-napf6",
           "description": "NaPF6 as salt",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "NaPF6",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find NaPF6 electrolyte evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "solvent-thf",
           "description": "THF as solvent",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "THF",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find THF solvent evidence"
         }
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。

To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments. More detailed pouch cell parameters are shown in Table S7.

evidence_chunks.content: The optical images in Figure S6 clearly indicate the formation of Na metal at the capacity of $350\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . Sodium dendrite could be recognized at the capacity of $450\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . The above results suggest that sodium plating start to intervene around $300\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ , and it will be safe to use HC within the capacity of $250\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ at $-20^{\circ}$ C.

evidence_chunks.content: The voltage profiles of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell consists of a plateau at 4.1 V and sloping regime between 3.6-2.5 V, contributing to an accumulative capacity of 306 mAh g $^{-1}$ (based on the mass of anode). The energy density is calculated to be 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ based on the total weight of cathode and anode, along with an average discharge potential of 3.62 V. ... It maintains 93.2% and 80.4% of the capacity at room temperature for testing at 0°C and -20°C, respectively. Nevertheless, cyclic stability is kept. It is worthwhile to mention that the safe capacity for HC working at -20°C is 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ , which is also around 80% of its capacity at room temperature.

Cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements were performed on the CHI760e electrochemical workstation (CH, Shanghai, China) over the potential range of 2.5–4.5 V and disparate sweep rates. For the preparation of hard carbon (HC) anode,"}, "index": 3}, {"content_type": "kg_rag", "content": "ABSTRACT
$Na_{3}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{2}F_{3}$ (NVPF) is considered as one of the most promising cathode materials for high-voltage sodium ion batteries, because of its high energy density and rapid ion diffusion ability. Yet, the insulating nature of $(PO_{4})^{3-}$ and the perishable $F^{-}$ cause the NVPF suffers from poor rate performance and short cycle durability. Herein, a particular three-dimensional double carbon network-intertwined NVPF nanospheres (notated as NVPF/CNTs) are successfully prepared by spray drying method. The coting carbon on the surface of NVPF can collect electrons at same time effectively improve lattice stability. And the unique conductive three-dimensional CNTs network framework has significantly improved the electrical conductivity between particles and enlarged the contact area between the cathode and electrolyte. evidence.text: Electrochemical performance of rechargeable NVP||HC full batteries with various electrolytes including a rationally designed electrolyte (1 M sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_{6})$ -diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2)/1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME)) and four typical electrolytes (1 M $NaPF_{6}$ -G2, 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ -DME, 0.5 M $NaPF_{6}$ -G2, and 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ -ethylene carbonate (EC)/diethyl carbonate (DEC)), have been thoroughly investigated.

evidence.chunk_id: 0180_A HighPower Rechargeable SodiumIon Full Battery Operating at 40 C::sec2::child11
evidence.paper_id: 0180_A HighPower Rechargeable SodiumIon Full Battery Operating at 40 C
evidence.text: Overall, an unprecedented high-power-density rechargeable NVP||HC full battery has been realized at $-40^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ without Na plating on HC anode surface, which can be attributed to the following three aspects: a) the designed high-solvation-entropy electrolyte (1 M $NaPF_{6}$ -G2/DME) with a small solvation cluster size possesses elevated ionic conductivity and larger $t_{Na}^{+}$ value at low temperatures compared with conventional electrolytes, facilitating $Na^{+}$ migration to the HC surface; b) a thin, NaF-rich SEI layer with small interfacial resistance is generated on the HC anode surface in the designed electrolyte, promoting $Na^{+}$ transport through the SEI; c) fast kinetics lowers the electrochemical polarization, hence suppressing Na plating on the HC anode.

evidence.chunk_id: 0180_A HighPower Rechargeable SodiumIon Full Battery Operating at 40 C::sec3
evidence.paper_id: 0180_A HighPower Rechargeable SodiumIon Full Battery Operating at 40 C
evidence.text: In conclusion, we successfully realize a high-power-density rechargeable sodium-ion full battery operated at $-40\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ without Na plating by rational electrolyte modulation. ... As a result, the HC anode in the designed electrolyte presents a remarkably high capacity of 284 mAh g $^{-1}$ (0.06 A g $^{-1}$ ) and 97 mAh g $^{-1}$ (2.10 A g $^{-1}$ ) at $-40\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ , respectively. Impressively, the NVP||HC full battery achieves a record-high power density of 1132.31 W kg $^{-1}$ ... and exhibits an outstanding capacity retention of 80.60% over 1400 cycles at $-40\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ .

evidence.text: Nevertheless, at low temperatures and high rates, the operating potential of HC can easily drop below 0 V versus $Na^{+}/Na$ due to the increased electrochemical impedance and polarization, inducing undesirable Na plating on HC anode.

evidence_chunks.content: Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

evidence_chunks.content: The voltage profiles of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell consists of a plateau at 4.1 V and sloping regime between 3.6-2.5 V, contributing to an accumulative capacity of 306 mAh g $^{-1}$ (based on the mass of anode). The energy density is calculated to be 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ based on the total weight of cathode and anode, along with an average discharge potential of 3.62 V. A stable cyclic performance similar to that in half-cell is achieved at $25^{\circ}$ C, as indicated by full cell F1 in Figure 5b. Ulteriorly, we tested the behavior of full cell under low temperature. Firstly, the performance of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}$ half-cell at 0°C and -20°C are measured and given in Figure S7a and S7b. The reversible capacity decreases with lowering the temperature. It maintains 93.2% and 80.4% of the capacity at room temperature for testing at 0°C and -20°C, respectively. Nevertheless, cyclic stability is kept. It is worthwhile to mention that the safe capacity for HC working at -20°C is 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ , which is also around 80% of its capacity at room temperature. Therefore, there is no need to change the mass ratio of the cathode and anode in the full cell for operating at low temperature.

For the cell cycled at $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ , the Coulombic efficiency decreases to only $95.3\%$ due to the Na plating/stripping. Hence the capacity of $250\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ is regarded as the reversible and safe capacity limitation for HC at $-20^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ .

Moreover, in situ Raman is adopted to investigate the ion storage behavior of HC at low temperature, and optical images were taken concomitantly. Figure S5 indicates no significant changes in Raman patterns during the entire discharge process, and the spectra are similar to that collected at $25^{\circ}$ C, advocating the same sodium storage mechanism in HC at both low and room temperature. The optical images in Figure S6 clearly indicate the formation of Na metal at the capacity of $350\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . Sodium dendrite could be recognized at the capacity of $450\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ .

Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

## 候选评估
### c1-naclo4-ecpc-0036
评估建议：候选 1M NaClO4/EC:PC(1:1 vol) 确为该体系文献所用，并给出 HC 在 -20 °C 无析钠的 250 mAh g^-1 安全容量；但同一电解液的全电池在 -20 °C 因不稳定 SEI 容量快速衰减，原文明确呼吁优化电解液以构建稳定低温 SEI，因此不足以据此推荐其作为低温全电池的适宜电解液，暂不推荐。
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaClO4 at 1 M concentration：原文方法部分明确写“1M NaClO4 solution ... was applied as the electrolyte”，与候选盐和浓度一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Solvent system is EC/PC at 1:1 by volume：同一方法句给出“ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume)”，与候选溶剂及体积比基准一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Electrolyte is employed in the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 || hard-carbon full cell：原文说明该电解液用于半电池和全电池，且全电池正极为 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3、负极为 HC，与目标体系匹配。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child16]
- Determine the reversible no-plating capacity limit of the HC anode at -20 C：原文以原位 XRD/Raman 及光学观察定出 -20 °C 下 250 mAh g^-1 为无析钠的可逆安全容量，300 mAh g^-1 时库仑效率降至 95.3% 出现析钠。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7]
- No-plating limit is established for the full cell itself at -20 C：250 mAh g^-1 无析钠结论是在 HC 半电池上测得；原文报告的 -20 °C 全电池呈现明显容量下降（前几循环大幅衰减，10 循环后回 25 °C 仅恢复约 82%），并未给出全电池层面的无析钠上限。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17]
- Electrolyte supports a stable low-temperature full cell (stable SEI)：原文指出 -20 °C 下形成更厚（约 23 nm）且不稳定的 SEI 导致全电池容量快速衰减，并明确结论为未来需优化电解液体系以构建稳定 SEI，说明该碳酸酯电解液并非低温全电池的适宜选择。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child15][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7::child0]
文献与候选的关联：1M NaClO4/EC:PC(1:1 vol) 是本研究中 HC 半电池与 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC 全电池实际使用的电解液；250 mAh g^-1 无析钠上限由 HC 半电池的原位 XRD/Raman 与光学观察确立，而全电池在 -20 °C 出现容量快速衰减与更厚/不稳定 SEI，两个测量分属半电池与全电池、不能相互替代。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17]
### c2-naclo4-ecpc-fec-0391
评估建议：The candidate electrolyte is compositionally identical to and experimentally used in the target NVPF||hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell in the source, so it is scientifically supported as an appropriate electrolyte for this system; however, the specific reversible no-plating capacity limit at -20 C remains unaddressed by the literature and would require direct experimental determination.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaClO4 at 1 mol/L：The paper's electrolyte is described as 1 M NaClO4 dissolved in EC/PC with FEC, matching the candidate salt and concentration. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Solvent system is EC:PC at 1:1 by volume：The source states ethylene carbonate (EC) and propylene carbonate (PC) in 1:1 v/v, matching the candidate solvent ratio and volume basis. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Contains 5 vol% FEC additive：The source explicitly reports 5 vol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) as the electrolyte additive. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec7::child0]
- Electrolyte applied in a NVPF||hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell：The full cells were assembled with NVPF/CNTs cathode and hard carbon anode (chemically pre-sodiated), using this electrolyte, matching the target full-cell configuration. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec8::child22]
- Operation at -20 C：The explicit -20 C measurements (diffusion coefficients and 96.8 mAh g-1 / capacity retention) are on NVPF/CNTs cathode half-cells or GITT; the full-cell rate/cycling data (Fig. 7) are not reported at -20 C, so low-temperature full-cell behavior of this electrolyte is not directly demonstrated. [0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec8::child22][0391_Lei 等 - 2024 - Large scale preparation of Na3V2PO42F3 with cross-linked double carbon network for high energy den::sec9::child2]

# 电解液正向设计 Skill

当性能段已经引用具体子图，但缺少电极或电池类型时，可在
`enrich_formulation_evidence` 的 request 中设置 `include_figure_context: true`。
工具沿同篇论文的明确图号、子图补取图注。筛选保留性能段和图注两个出处，
不会把图注中其他子图的温度、倍率或循环数补到当前性能结果上。
同论文、相邻段落或同一种盐本身不能证明属于同一组试验。

## 任务要求与测试类型

整理配方前，先检查候选是否报告了用户要求的温度、倍率和电池配置下的结果。
标题相关或正文分别出现这些条件，不代表同一次试验满足全部条件。
先补取与目标工况相符的性能段，再整理对应配方的浓度、比例和添加剂用量。
若已选候选缺少目标条件下的结果，应检查本轮检索返回的其他候选，
不要围绕同一候选重复查询，或把另一温度下的表现当作目标条件的结果。

先把用户明确要求的条件写入 `constraint_records`，不要在筛选过程中增加用户没有
提出的性能要求。放电容量、倍率性能和循环寿命是不同测试。用户要求某温度、某倍率
的放电结果时，不将缺少同温度、同倍率的循环寿命结果记为阻断缺口。
`unresolved_gaps` 应对应候选组成缺失或用户必需条件，额外研究建议写进验证计划。
若原文已经明写倍率与电流的对应关系，应引用该原句，不将它再次列为缺失。
用户给出的数值与单位须原样保留在至少一个检索查询中，包括括号内的电流或容量。
不能用倍率替换具体电流后就认为已经检索了全部条件。具体标识未命中时先核查
原标识的字面检索结果，再继续扩展候选；不由系统填写论文名称或配方。
在形成候选前，逐项检查用户目标是否已有相关证据。近似温度是选材目标，仍需
优先考察接近该目标的实际测试结果；室温表现不能替代高温或低温使用依据。
近似目标没有容差时不虚构数值阈值。报告必须写出文献实测条件，并在 next_steps
交代目标条件下的验证；不能省略这个目标后把基础配方写成完整解决方案。
成本等定性目标也逐项说明已有依据和待验证事项，不能随硬条件通过而消失。
联合条件的 `electrode` 只写正负极材料，`cell_configuration` 单独写软包、扣式等
电池类型，不把两种信息混写在一个字段中。

## 适用场景

- 用户要求设计适用于特定工况（低温、高压、长循环等）的钠离子电池电解液；
- 用户提供多套候选配方要求评分筛选。

## 证据能力选择

检索查询根据当前用户问题生成，使用英文。先检索用户给出的电极对、电池形式、
温度、倍率或电流及目标性能，不预先限定用户没有指定的盐、溶剂或添加剂。
可把这些条件拆成多个查询，用 `search_literature_multiview` 合并结果；
不必在每个查询中同时塞入所有条件。用户给出的具体电流、容量或电压范围也可用来
定位相关实验，不能只用宽泛的“低温电解液”替代这些信息。
对于有辨识度的电极缩写、明确电流或容量，`resolve_literature_papers` 可补充
字面检索。向量结果未覆盖这些具体标识时，先用原标识检查字面命中，避免继续
围绕不符合电极或电流条件的论文扩展检索。使用用户原本给出的标识，不猜作者或题名。先查看返回的正文命中，
再决定是否值得进行论文内检索；无关的引用、另一种电池的结果不能用于推荐。
找到相关论文后，使用论文内检索分别取得组成、测试条件和性能，核对是否属于
同一配方与同一测试。机理或替代体系检索用于解决实际缺口，不是必做的检索次数。
参数建议：`top_k=10`，`per_query_top_k=8`，`max_per_paper=2`。
盐未指定时，不要只锚定向量检索第一次命中的盐：先用 `kg_query` 的
`find_materials_for_condition`，把 `material_types` 设为 `["SodiumSalt", "Electrolyte"]`，
查目标温度/条件下测试过的盐与电解液，再对返回的具体盐名逐个补向量检索。
双盐体系必须用「dual salt + 具体盐名」组合查询才能召回，单独查一个盐名往往召不回对应论文。
后续查询依据已有结果和 `DecisionState.evidence_gaps` 调整。

## 工作流

### 逆向设计例外：先诊断，筛选仅决定能否推荐配方

对于容量骤降、首圈库仑效率低、高压衰减、阻抗增长等 `inverse_design` 问题，先从检索证据中建立至少两个可区分的电解液侧假设，并提出能区分它们的 EIS、Raman、XPS、LSV、ICP、产气或对照实验。仍执行候选配方筛选，但筛选 `hold` 只禁止“推荐进入实验”的完整配方；不得因此省略诊断、混杂因素和条件化调整方向。报告必须区分“已被证据支持的诊断事实”与“待验证的调整方向”。

1. 解析用户目标与约束；把用户要求的每项条件写成结构化 `constraint_records`，例如：
   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。
   推荐前逐项核对用户要求与检查条件，避免漏掉正极、负极、电池形式、温度、倍率或指标定义。
   检索前先解释用户给出的数值条件：它描述什么物理量、单位如何理解、哪些信息尚不明确。
   这一解释依据用户描述的工作场景，在检索前定下，不能由后来检索到的论文或知识图谱记录
   反过来改写；其它论文里恰好出现同样的 “N C” 写法，只说明那些论文的用法，不能用来判断
   用户这句话。
   温度与倍率的单位必须分清。省略度符号的 C 不能直接视为充放电倍率。
   按它在句中的位置判断：直接修饰电芯、电池或其使用环境时（如 “a pouch cell at -30 C”、
   “a full cell around 50 C”），是温度；只有与充放电动作或倍率词连用时
   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，
   此时暂缓推荐，而不是把两种解释同时写成两条互斥的数值约束。
   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们
   同时写成必需的 `required_component`；每个选项应作为独立候选分别比较，不叠加互斥的必需组分。
   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，
   用现有 `evidence_claim` 表达候选须有相应工况下的直接测试依据，而非把近似目标
   改成精确相等、单边不等式或自行设定容差。逐候选判断时，`supported` 须引用该
   候选的实际测试条件与性能原句，`basis` 写清实测条件与目标的差别及其关联依据。
   只有其他工况的结果、测试建议或机理预测时，不能据此判近似工况要求已满足。
   没有相应测试依据就保留 `not_found` 并补证，不能删掉该要求后批准推荐，再把它
   放进 `next_steps`。有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的
   差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列。电极、电池形式和其他明确要求仍须检查。
   联合条件也须保留近似目标的含义：不得把近似值写成 `target_context` 中要求
   精确匹配的数值。近似工况及其电极、全电池归属可写在同一 `evidence_claim`
   中，引用实际共同测试的结果；组分身份等与工况无关的要求不并入该测试条件组。
   “低成本”等定性目标须区分文献提出的成本动机与已量化的价格优势；未提供价格数据
   时不得称已验证低成本。数值明确的用户要求仍按原值建立硬约束，不得因此放宽。
   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`
   会让任何数字都通过，等于没有检查。这类“须被报告/须成立”的指标改用
   `kind: "evidence_claim"`（见下），把该指标写成一句断言。
   `field_presence` 只用于检查候选的配方字段（`concentration_mol_l`、
   `solvent_ratios`、`additives` 等）是否显式填写，绝不用于表达“某项性能必须被报告”。
   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成
   `"kind": "field_presence", "field": "additives"` 这类把性能指标错配到配方字段的约束。
   ```json
   {
     "request": {
       "candidates": candidates,
       "constraint_records": [
         {
           "constraint_id": "temp-low",
           "description": "operating temperature ≤ -20°C",
           "kind": "temperature",
           "operator": "<=",
           "value": -20,
           "unit": "°C",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find low-temperature cycling evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "electrode-hard-carbon",
           "description": "hard carbon anode",
           "kind": "electrode_material",
           "evidence_terms": ["hard carbon", "hard-carbon"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find hard carbon anode evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "cell-half",
           "description": "sodium half-cell configuration",
           "kind": "cell_configuration",
           "evidence_terms": ["half-cell", "half cell", "Na||HC", "HC||Na", "pure Na"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find half-cell configuration evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "field-concentration",
           "description": "explicit salt concentration must be present",
           "kind": "field_presence",
           "field": "concentration_mol_l",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": false
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "salt-napf6",
           "description": "NaPF6 as salt",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "NaPF6",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find NaPF6 electrolyte evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "solvent-thf",
           "description": "THF as solvent",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "THF",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find THF solvent evidence"
         }
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。

Being abundant in nature, biomass is the most attractive precursors for producing hard carbon (HC) anodes for Na-ion batteries. The complexity of precursor has discouraged the development of a benchmark in synthesizing biomass-derived HC. Using longan peel waste as a model material, a facile two-step thermal treatment is proposed to avoid the self-activation, resulting in the HC with appropriate surface area and pore size distribution. A reversible capacity of 309 mAh g $^{-1}$ is delivered, with an initial Coulombic efficiency of 80%. To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments. More detailed pouch cell parameters are shown in Table S7.

All button cells (CR2032-type) were assembled in an argon-filled glovebox (MIKROUNA of Universal, $O_{2} < 0.01$ ppm, $H_{2}O < 0.01$ ppm). As for the fabrication of the positive electrode, a uniform slurry (active material, carbon black, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 6:3:1 mixed in N-methyl-2-pyrrolidinone) was coated on the aluminum foil and dried in vacuum at 70 °C for 12 h. The mass of active material loading was controlled at 1–2 mg. Metallic sodium plate was used as anode, and glass fiber (Whatman, GF/F) was used as separator. The solution consisted of 1 M NaClO $_{4}$ dissolved in ethylene carbonate

(EC) and propylene carbonate (PC) (1:1 in $\nu/\mathrm{v}$ ) with 5 vol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) was employed as an electrolyte. The battery test system (NEWARE CT-4008) was used for galvanostatic charge/discharge measurement with various current densities at a voltage range of 2.5–4.5 V versus $\mathrm{Na}^{+}/\mathrm{Na}$ . Cyclic voltammetry (CV) measurements were performed on the CHI760e electrochemical workstation (CH, Shanghai, China) over the potential range of 2.5–4.5 V and disparate sweep rates. The electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurements were implemented by CHI760e with the frequency ranging from $10^{-2}$ to $10^{5}$ Hz with an alternating current amplitude of 5 mV. For the preparation of hard carbon (HC) anode, the slurry consisted of HC, carbon black, and PVDF in a weight ratio of 8:1:1 mixed in NMP, was coated on the copper foil and dried in vacuum for 12 h. The mass of active material loading on the anode of NVPF/CNTs half cells was controlled at 0.5–1 mg. The NVPF/CNTs||HC full cells were assembled based on CR2032-type coin battery, and tested at the voltage range of 1.5–4.4 V.

Herein, a particular three-dimensional double carbon network-intertwined NVPF nanospheres (notated as NVPF/CNTs) are successfully prepared by spray drying method. In summary, a hard carbon material for NIBs is fabricated from low-cost biomass waste using a facile two-step thermal treatment. Compared to direct high-temperature carbonization, the pre-treatment at a medium temperature is beneficial to avoiding the selfactivation effect of impurities. An appropriate surface area and pore size distribution are obtained, enabling a stable capacity of around 300 mAh g $^{-1}$ . It also shows excellent performance at a temperature as low as -20 °C. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaClO4 at 1 M concentration：原文方法部分明确写“1M NaClO4 solution ... was applied as the electrolyte”，与候选盐和浓度一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Solvent system is EC/PC at 1:1 by volume：同一方法句给出“ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume)”，与候选溶剂及体积比基准一致。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]
- Electrolyte is employed in the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 || hard-carbon full cell：原文说明该电解液用于半电池和全电池，且全电池正极为 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3、负极为 HC，与目标体系匹配。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child16]
- Determine the reversible no-plating capacity limit of the HC anode at -20 C：原文以原位 XRD/Raman 及光学观察定出 -20 °C 下 250 mAh g^-1 为无析钠的可逆安全容量，300 mAh g^-1 时库仑效率降至 95.3% 出现析钠。 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec7]

source_refs.raw_quote: Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

source_refs.raw_quote: The voltage profiles of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell consists of a plateau at 4.1 V and sloping regime between 3.6-2.5 V, contributing to an accumulative capacity of 306 mAh g $^{-1}$ (based on the mass of anode). The energy density is calculated to be 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ based on the total weight of cathode and anode, along with an average discharge potential of 3.62 V. A stable cyclic performance similar to that in half-cell is achieved at $25^{\circ}$ C, as indicated by full cell F1 in Figure 5b. Ulteriorly, we tested the behavior of full cell under low temperature. Firstly, the performance of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}$ half-cell at 0°C and -20°C are measured and given in Figure S7a and S7b. The reversible capacity decreases with lowering the temperature. It maintains 93.2% and 80.4% of the capacity at room temperature for testing at 0°C and -20°C, respectively. Nevertheless, cyclic stability is kept. It is worthwhile to mention that the safe capacity for HC working at -20°C is 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ , which is also around 80% of its capacity at room temperature. Therefore, there is no need to change the mass ratio of the cathode and anode in the full cell for operating at low temperature.

Figure S5 indicates no significant changes in Raman patterns during the entire discharge process, and the spectra are similar to that collected at $25^{\circ}$ C, advocating the same sodium storage mechanism in HC at both low and room temperature. source_refs.raw_quote: The optical images in Figure S6 clearly indicate the formation of Na metal at the capacity of $350\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . Sodium dendrite could be recognized at the capacity of $450\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . The above results suggest that sodium plating start to intervene around $300\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ , and it will be safe to use HC within the capacity of $250\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The performance of the electrode is not only affected by the active materials but also governed by the other components such as electrolyte and binder. It has been demonstrated by Palacín et al. the importance of electrolyte formulation for the stable performance of HC at low temperature. $^{[21]}$ The binder plays a vital role in maintaining the structural integrity, but its effect under low temperature is not clear yet. Therefore, electrodes using several typical binders, including CMC, NaAg and PVDF are compared in Figure 3c for their low temperature performance. Among the three binders, PVDF exhibits the highest reversible capacity and the smallest resistance drop. This difference can be explained by the thermal stability of binder materials, as well-studied in Li-ion batteries. $^{[29,30]}$ To state in a simple way, PVDF has the lowest glass transition temperature ( $T_{g}$ ) about -38 °C compared to CMC (121.7 °C) and NaAg (95.3 °C).

source_refs.raw_quote: Therefore, there is no need to change the mass ratio of the cathode and anode in the full cell for operating at low temperature. As expected, the $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell also demonstrates a capacity reduction at 0 °C in the first several cycles and reaches stable capacity retention of 244 mAh g $^{-1}$ (F2 in Figure 5b). However, when the full cell was charged/discharged at -20°C, a significant drop in capacity is observed, particularly during the first 5 cycles. It may lie in the increased resistance on the anode side as reflected by EIS. The dynamic property of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ at different temperatures is also evaluated using galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT), as indicated in Figure 5c. From the calculation, the diffusion coefficient of Na-ions ( $D_{Na}^{+}$ ) at 25°C is in the range of $10^{-9}$ to $10^{-10}$ cm $^{2}$ s $^{-1}$ . The value is only slightly decreased at 0°C. In sharp contrast, the $D_{Na}^{+}$ value is about one magnitude lower at -25 °C than that at 25°C. The slow $Na^{+}$ diffusion is in agreement with the EIS results that the thicker SEI film would affect the ion diffusion. After testing at $-20^{\circ}C$ for 10 cycles, the same cell (F3) was put back to $25^{\circ}C$ and its capacity gradually recovered and regained ca. 82% of the capacity at $25^{\circ}C$ .

source_refs.raw_quote: In summary, a hard carbon material for NIBs is fabricated from low-cost biomass waste using a facile two-step thermal treatment. Compared to direct high-temperature carbonization, the pre-treatment at a medium temperature is beneficial to avoiding the selfactivation effect of impurities. An appropriate surface area and pore size distribution are obtained, enabling a stable capacity of around 300 mAh g $^{-1}$ . It also shows excellent performance at a temperature as low as -20 °C. A safe and reversible capacity of 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ can be obtained without Na plating at -20 °C, as evidenced by in situ XRD and Raman tests. As-prepared HC also delivers stable performance in the full cell coupling with a $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}$ cathode, demonstrated an energy density of 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ (based on the total weight of electrode) with decent cyclic stability at room temperature. Nevertheless, the full cell shows a fast capacity fading at -20 °C due to both the increased resistance and continuous consumption of Na ions. It calls for building stable SEI under low temperature in future studies.

source_refs.raw_quote: Overall, an unprecedented high-power-density rechargeable NVP||HC full battery has been realized at $-40^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ without Na plating on HC anode surface, which can be attributed to the following three aspects: a) the designed high-solvation-entropy electrolyte (1 M $NaPF_{6}$ -G2/DME) with a small solvation cluster size possesses elevated ionic conductivity and larger $t_{Na}^{+}$ value at low temperatures compared with conventional electrolytes, facilitating $Na^{+}$ migration to the HC surface; b) a thin, NaF-rich SEI layer with small interfacial resistance is generated on the HC anode surface in the designed electrolyte, promoting $Na^{+}$ transport through the SEI; c) fast kinetics lowers the electrochemical polarization, hence suppressing Na plating on the HC anode.
